confirmedFindings.title: Verification result can belong to different envelope
confirmedFindings.mechanism: Claimed contentDigestSha256Hex is the entire query key; fallback id/version/signature omits manifest bytes. staleTime=Infinity can reuse cached signature-valid for other content. Parser validates digest syntax only. Detail bases installability on that result and passes it with current envelope. This is result association failure, not an Ed25519 flaw.

confirmedFindings.title: Action failures have no local recovery/feedback
confirmedFindings.mechanism: Mutations have only onSuccess invalidation. Consumers inspect isPending, not error/isError. performInstall/blockPack/uninstall await mutateAsync without catch; ConfirmDialog invokes void callback without awaiting. Rollback/setEnabled mutate have no visible failure. Production QueryClient has no global mutation error handler. Partial writes before audit failure are possible and cross-table nontransactionality is documented, not itself a violation.
